purpose: Curated maintenance index for the important public, source-review, and implementation variants of the four unnumbered Davis--Kahan Section 2 headline theorems. This is not a source census and does not determine the 29-result denominator.

authority.rule: A declaration is source-faithful because the result ledger selects it and records the covered source atoms. The theorem name must not encode source exactness. When any important variant changes, review its real, complex, and RCLike siblings together and update this index.

roles.ledger_witness: Declaration currently selected by the result ledger as evidence for a source clause.
roles.fixed_field_api: Convenience public API specialized to real or complex scalars; it may be stronger or otherwise differently parameterized than the ledger witness.
roles.implementation_engine: Stronger or proof-oriented theorem retained to implement another statement boundary.
roles.probe: Exploration-only declaration. Never ledger evidence until it compiles, is promoted to production, and the ledger is explicitly retargeted.
